_map: The map this chapter opens (his, 2026-09-29: 地图分步打开): the prologue (古一 to 古四) is 石坳村 and 蒙山, and the road up to the temple. A corridor walks the player anyway; the map is what the page greys and Move refuses past (world.mjs mapOf).

say.zh: 山外的路，你还没走过。先把眼前的事做完。
say.en: You have never walked the roads beyond the mountain. Finish what is before you first.

_locks: Story gates (his ruling, 2026-09-28: 修行是遇见银月、加入宗门开始的，先走剧情). Until the player reaches `until` — the outer court's first night, the day they join the sect — the prologue keeps these shut: no realm, no 修为 bar and no 修为 gained; no 灵石 (the hall's three are the first); no 人间功课, no 开府, no 问卦, no 差事 or 传闻, nothing on the road, no 闭关. 体力, the 储物袋, 录, 书 and the 恩仇簿 stay. On `until` and every scene after it all of it opens, at 练气一层 from 0 (state.mjs lockedOf, lockReset; rules/locks.mjs). `say` is the refusal of a shut verb.

say.zh: 你还是个凡人。修行、功课、差事这些，要进了沉鼎观才轮得到你。
say.en: You are still a mortal. Cultivation, chores and errands wait until you join Chending Temple.

_title: The arc's own name, no number: the player is told the 回 — 古一 up to 00-yinyue, 古二 from 00-cliff (book.json via the scenes' `hui`, rules/hui.mjs).

summary.zh: 蒙山脚下的猎户家，马家的租，一张弓。你和爹越过「勿入」的断碑，暴雨里坠谷；崖根下，一个叫锁儿的孩子死在你手里。你救起一只断了八尾的小银狐——银月。她伤重沉睡在吴婆婆的狐纹木牌里；半年后，舅舅带来沉鼎观开山门的告示。三试凭你自己的腿、脑子和胆子；蠪侄林里，跟在你身后的石蛋死了。外门收下了你；告示栏上，公中的告示落款「马师兄」。
summary.en: A hunter's home under Mount Meng, the Ma family's rent, and a bow. You and your father cross the broken stele that says Do not enter; in the storm you fall into a valley, where a boy called Suo'er dies holding your hand; you save a little silver fox with eight tails cut away — Yinyue. Badly hurt, she sleeps in Granny Wu's fox token; half a year on, your uncle brings the notice that Chending Temple opens its gate. You pass the three trials on your own legs, wits and nerve; in the Longzhi wood, Shidan, walking behind you, dies. The outer court takes you in; on its notice board, the common-fund notice is signed "Senior Brother Ma".

intro.zh: 蒙山脚下的石坳村，十七户人家，一户打猎。那一户，就是你家。
intro.en: Shi'ao village under Mount Meng: seventeen households, one of them hunters. That one is yours.

mystery.zh: 吴婆婆的木牌上，为什么刻着一只九尾的狐狸？
mystery.en: Why is a nine-tailed fox carved on Granny Wu's token?

_aliases: Scene ids an older save may still hold, and the scene of this chapter nearest to each (state.mjs fitWorld). The prologue-v3 rewrite (2026-09-28): every scene of the v0 and v1 prologues that came before the trials goes to 石坳村, where the story now begins (the name card asks again; roots, bag and progress are kept); the trials and the hall keep their ids; the old outer-court practice goes to the outer court; 夫诸 and the north go to the notice board, the prologue's last scene. A save that walked only the retired scenes and stands on one the rewrite kept (his: v1 put him at 00-waimen) begins again at 石坳村 too (state.mjs fitWorld).
